subject: E-Commerce
title: Bestseller Lists as Mind Control
description: A fast breakdown of Bestseller Lists as Mind Control for builders.

hook.text: Bestseller badges increase click-through rates by 45%. People assume popularity equals quality.

buildup.text: The bandwagon effect makes popular items more popular. Success breeds more success in a feedback loop.

discovery.text: Amazon updates bestseller lists hourly. A early spike of sales can trigger the badge, creating more sales.

twist.text: Some authors buy their own books in bulk to game bestseller lists. The badge is worth more than the cost.

climax.text: Bestseller lists are self-reinforcing. The list creates the sales, not the other way around.

punchline.text: 45% more clicks with a badge. The bestseller list doesn't report success—it.

quiz.question: Why do bestseller badges increase sales?
options: The bandwagon effect makes people assume popular means good
